{{Otheruses|Squad Two}}
'''Squad Two''' was a squad of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In addition to the standard configuration, the squadrons [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were equipped with enhanced [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers. The ships were painted gray with dark gray markings to identify their squad affiliation.
